name: Pipwyrn · Gremlet #34
description:
A pocket wyvern with a fang-y grin. Hides things, then helps you look for them.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Pipwyrn in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
